messages:
Maya R: Heads up — noticed a weird prorate on the GCP Marketplace invoice for REDWOOD-ENT-2026-03. Looks like the reseller passed through a full-month commit instead of prorating our mid-month upgrade. Invoice attached: <https://invoices.redwood/INV-GCP-20260314>. Can finance take a look? /cc @Jon P @Priya S

Jon P: I see it. Line item `gcp-marketplace:reserved-instance-commit` shows charge for 730h on 2026-03-01 even though we upgraded on 2026-03-14. Expected prorate to 17 days. Amount off by ~USD 18,437.50.

Priya S: Filing a ticket with Partner Support now. I need the reseller invoice number and the contract effective date to push the credit. Maya can you confirm the upgrade timestamp and the billing account ID?

Maya R: Upgrade timestamp: 2026-03-14T09:42Z, billing acct: 9876543210, reseller id: RSLR-3991. Invoice number: INV-GCP-20260314. Uploaded our commit change memo to the drive.

BillingBot: New ticket created: GCP-PS-11287 — 'prorate dispute for reseller charge'. Assigned to GCP Partner Support. ETA 3 business days. (automated) :spiral_calendar:

GCP Partner Support: Thanks for the details, @Maya R. We reviewed the invoice and it looks like the reseller billing pipeline applied the original commit window because the commit change wasn't propagated before the cycle generated. We can issue a one-time credit equal to the prorated difference once the partner confirms. Please attach the signed amendment and the platform change record.

Maya R: Uploaded signed amendment and the platform change confirmation to the ticket (link: <https://redwood.internal/drive/commit-change-MAR14>). Also included the SaaS onboarding ticket ID (PLAT-8892).

GCP Partner Support: Confirmed receipt. We will process a credit for USD 18,437.50 to be applied to the next invoice. Credit ref: CR-GCP-98765. You should see it reflected in 7-10 business days. We will post a follow-up message when the credit posts.

Alex H: For bookkeeping: Priya, can you log the expected credit in AR as 'pending vendor credit' and include it in March reconciliation? Also please create a JIRA to track clearance once the credit posts.

Priya S: Done. Logged as pending (GL: 2050) and created JIRA FIN-4321 to track. Will update thread when credit posts. Thanks — closing internal loop after confirmation. :white_check_mark:
